Package edu.cnu.mdi.json

package edu.cnu.mdi.json
  • Class
    Description
    JsonNodeData
    Immutable value object carried as the user-object of every DefaultMutableTreeNode in the JSON tree.
    JsonNodeData.Kind
    Classifies a JSON tree node for color selection in JsonTreeCellRenderer.
    JsonRawPane
    The left half of the JsonSplitPane: a read-only, syntax-colored view of raw JSON text with incremental search highlighting.
    JsonSearchBar
    A compact search bar that drives text highlighting in the raw pane and match navigation in the tree pane.
    JsonSplitPane
    Split-pane panel that displays a JSON file in two synchronized views: colorized raw text on the left and a collapsible tree on the right, with a shared search bar along the bottom.
    JsonTreeCellRenderer
    Cell renderer for the JSON tree that applies the same dark-theme color palette used by the raw-text pane.
    JsonTreePane
    The right half of the JsonSplitPane: a collapsible tree view of a parsed JSON structure.
